name: AI Agent tool: what Google ads is a competitor running?

parameters.content:
# Give an AI Agent access to Google Ads intelligence

Equips an AI Agent with a tool to inspect live and historical Google ads for any competitor domain or advertiser ID. Ask: *"What search ads is Monday.com running right now?"*

## Setup (once)

**1. Get an Apify token** — https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations

**2. Create the n8n credential**
Credentials → New → **Header Auth**
- Name: `Apify API`
- Header name: `Authorization`
- Header value: `Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`

Every HTTP node here points at that credential by name. No token is stored in this file.

## OCR & copy coverage
96% of Google text ads exist only as screenshot images. The tool returns OCR-extracted headlines and descriptions with color segmentation, so the LLM can analyze actual ad copy.

## Cost

Pay-per-event: from $0.70 per 1,000 ads returned ($0.0012 on Free down to $0.0007 on Gold) plus $0.01 per competitor checked in monitor mode. Only ads genuinely new (judged by Google firstShown date) are returned.

Current pricing: https://apify.com/sumitr_mardy/google-ads-monitor/pricing

Actor: https://apify.com/sumitr_mardy/google-ads-monitor
Templates & docs: https://github.com/sumitrmardy/google-ads-monitor-api

options.systemMessage: You are a competitive intelligence and digital advertising analyst. When asked about a competitor's Google ads, call the Google Ads Intelligence Tool. Analyze their messaging strategy, value propositions, headlines, call-to-actions, and targeted countries. Highlight recent campaigns and format breakdown (TEXT, IMAGE, VIDEO).

parameters.toolDescription: Searches Google Ads Transparency Center for active ads, copy, and creative history for competitor domains or advertiser IDs. Provide targets in `targets`.

values.name: targets
values.description: A JSON array of domains or advertiser IDs to check, e.g. ["monday.com"].
